markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (94%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1], 98% reliability, backbone agreement, and 0% invasive risk support a benign read.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 94%, InSitu 6%, Invasive 0%, Normal 0% | Strong Benign lead; low InSitu |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (90% target; 90% test coverage, n=132) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 68% OOD, 12 regions kept [F6] | Typical input; error AUROC 0.70 |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top class | Independent backbones match suggestion |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Benign (80%) [F5]; contrast Normal (87%) | Reference neighbors support Benign |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical text score (-0.45 contribution) [F2]; AI spot check 18/20 · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 3) · context · Below-typical score (+0.43 toward invasive) [F3]; AI spot check 8/20 · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.32 contribution) [F4]; AI spot check 12/20 · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.20), unreliable concept; AI spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.15 contribution); AI spot check 19/20 · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-3 risk regions beats random removal (drop +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064 includes 0); mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20), normal lobules (0/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Duct-confined atypia in regions 4, 5, 6 represents InSitu (6% probability) or region 11 holds focal invasion.
- Simulated frozen-section margins [F7] are positive; lateral (100%), inferior (99%), and medial (98%) near the 100% threshold.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9, 11**: Inspect highest tile risk (regions 8, 9) and invasion/pleomorphism signals in region 11.
2. **Regions 4, 5, 6**: Verify atypical cells remain duct-confined and exclude InSitu (6%).
3. **Regions 0, 1, 2, 3**: Confirm benign tubules (0, 1, 2) and inspect inferior, lateral, medial margins.
